notes.title: Mac graphics update
notes.content:
Grab the Bottle has been updated for systems running macOS. The update should fix lots of the graphical glitches found in the game earlier. 

Note, that the patch can in some cases break the splash screen colors. This only affects the Kamina Dimension splash screen and we are working on finding a cause for this rather odd but harmless anomaly. 

If you still continue to have glitching graphics after updating the game, please contact us with detailed information so we can try to pinpoint the causes.


Cheers,
Kamina Dimension

notes.title: Grab the Bottle Autumn Update released!
notes.content:
Grab the Bottle version 1.2.0 is now released! We are calling this The Autumn Update and it brings some important balance changes to the game, as well as support for different languages.

Found in this update are the following:
[list][*]3 new languages: The game is now fully localized to Chinese, Japanese and Finnish. We have now the support for more languages, you can expect more in the future.
[*]Rebalanced the difficulty a bit. Player now has 3 hitpoints instead of 2. Pulling back items is also bit faster now.
[*]Expanded the tutorials 
[*]New menu interface graphics
[*]Bugfixes
[/list]

More is still to come in the future.

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension Crew

notes.title: Reviews and feedback wanted:)
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone! [/h1]

It's now been almost a month since the release of Grab the Bottle. We've gotten a lot of useful feedback and many of you have made videos on YouTube. Thank you for getting the game and supporting us!

If you liked the game, [b]we would appreciate if you wrote a short review on Steam.[/b] Reviews greatly aid us while we continue to make updates to the game and help possible new players to find Grab the Bottle:)

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension

notes.title: Huge update released, full release May 22nd.
notes.content:
We are very excited to tell you, that last 2 chapters of the single player campaign for Grab the Bottle are now released. This update brings the game to its version 9.9, which means we are almost done with early access. 

This is the final big early access update to Grab the Bottle, in one week (May 22) the game will transition out of early access and have its official release!

Included in the update are:
[list]
    [*]2 new chapters, bringing the final total level count to 45!
    [*]Whole new power up -system to help the player through difficult levels
    [*]New music 
    [*]Lots of small bug fixes
[/list] 

The final big thing missing before the launch is now achievements. Those will be added with the game's full release on 05/22.

We also have a cool new trailer coming tomorrow.

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension

notes.content:
We have just released a big update for Grab the Bottle.


The patch contains the following:

[list]
    [*]Teen Chapter, featuring new art and 8 levels in different settings

notes.title: Big update and trading cards coming very soon, multiplayer delayed.
notes.content:
It's been really busy at the office and we've been working hard on more content for Grab the Bottle. Thanks to your valuable feedback, we have been able to improve the playability and other aspects of our game!

As we announced in our Steam Greenlight trailer, Grab the Bottle would eventually get a local multiplayer mode. Unfortunately due to the limited resources we are dealing with, the multiplayer mode will be delayed until the single player experience has been fully implemented and polished. Don't worry though. With a new update just behind the corner, you should be expecting new levels, Steam trading cards and more!

We hope you will understand and wish you the best! 

Stay hydrated.
- Kamina Dimension

notes.title: Grab the Bottle Demo updated!
notes.content:
Heyo and Happy New Year!

We recently updated the free demo version of Grab the Bottle to reflect the current state of early access version bit better! Note however, that the demo version still doesn't include all the new features found in the early access.

Some major updates include:

[list]
    [*]2 lives before the game is over and updated graphics for getting hurt (Currently w.i.p. for the sleeveless arm)
    [*]Better handling for the hand and more consistent speed while rolling back
    [*]More consistent rollback distance when opening doors
    [*]Updates to attic level
[/list] 

The demo version still has few known bugs and some of the options from the full game are not there.  We will be updating the demo once the next major patch of the early access version is available.

Cheers,
Kamina Dimension

notes.title: Grab the Bottle is now on Early Access!
notes.content:
Just in time for holidays, Grab the Bottle Early Access launch for PC is here! 

The Early Access version at this time includes 18+ levels of puzzles for you to crack. We hope you have fun playing the game and we would also like to wish everyone Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays!

Also we would like to ask you to send all your bug finds and suggestions about the game to us! 

IMPORTANT!
Known bugs & incoming features:
- Currently only supported full screen resolutions are 16:9 resolutions, we are working on fixing this
- Steam Controller currently works best on regular joystick mode
- Input switching for controllers
- Toggle for Grab & Pull button
- Various bugs involving grabbing & pulling in different situations
- Linux and Mac versions coming soon

notes.title: Grab the Bottle Demo Update
notes.content:
The demo for Grab the Bottle has been updated with a patch that should fix some bugs and add couple of new features. 

Main changes:
-You can now speed up without having an object grabbed
-Grabbing and not starting to pull and object no longer results in death
-Minor changes to controls
-"How to play" is now accessible from Options
-Fixed bug where outlines didn't always show on objects
-Minor bug fixes
